findings.detail: No font-display on this @font-face for "Source Serif": the browser default (auto) can hide the text for up to about 3 seconds while the font downloads. Rule: set font-display on every web font: swap by default, fallback or optional by choice, block only for icon fonts. Reason: hidden text delays first paint and LCP; fix the shift from a late swap with a metric-matched fallback, not by hiding text. Fix: add "font-display: swap;" to this rule.

font-display: auto on this @font-face for "Source Serif" is the same as leaving it out: the browser decides, and it can hide the text for up to about 3 seconds while the font downloads. Rule: set font-display on every web font: swap by default, fallback or optional by choice, block only for icon fonts. Reason: hidden text delays first paint and LCP; fix the shift from a late swap with a metric-matched fallback, not by hiding text. Fix: change it to "font-display: swap;".

font-display: block on this @font-face for "Brand Display" can hide the text for up to about 3 seconds while the font downloads. Rule: set font-display on every web font: swap by default, fallback or optional by choice, block only for icon fonts. Reason: hidden text delays first paint and LCP; fix the shift from a late swap with a metric-matched fallback, not by hiding text. Fix: change it to "font-display: swap;". Keep block only if "Brand Display" is an icon font.

This @font-face for "Docs Symbols", which looks like an icon font, has no font-display, so the browser decides how the icons load. Rule: set font-display on every web font: swap by default, fallback or optional by choice, block only for icon fonts. Reason: an icon font's fallback is not readable text, so swap would put ligature names or empty boxes on screen until the icons load; block hides them briefly instead. Fix: add "font-display: block;" to this rule.

"Code Mono" declares weight 600 here (@font-face), but nothing in the scanned files sets font-weight 600 where this family could apply. Fix: remove this weight, unless something the scan cannot see applies it (styles set by scripts, CMS content).
